Based on the image provided, here is a precise description of the UI elements in the **bottom-left corner**:

*   **The Button:** Yes, there is a **circular, dark grey button** with a white **'N'** letter in the center. This is indeed a map compass or orientation button.
*   **Overlap/Obstruction:** The circular 'N' button **does overlap and obstruct text**. It is positioned directly on top of the last line of the paragraph at the bottom of the screen.
*   **Exact Text:** The visible text near and partially behind the button reads:  
    "...individual file in the repair studio. **Nothing here touches the** originals."  
    The word "**the**" is partially covered by the right edge of the circular button.
*   **Spatial Relationships:** The left edge of the 'N' button is flush with or very close to the left margin of the text container. The bottom edge of the button aligns roughly with the baseline of the final line of text ("originals.").
